rules: Every discovered record remains CANDIDATE_UNREVIEWED until human review.
Similarity does not imply historical descent, common origin or diffusion.
Publication, online, issue, index and discovery dates are preserved separately where available.
Archaeological observations are separated from inferred symbolic, ritual, social or cognitive meaning.
Ancient-DNA ancestry, cultural affiliation, technology, language and social identity are not interchangeable variables.
Historical diagnosis or identity is never inferred from resemblance to modern biomedical categories.

new_candidates.title: Recovering signatures of archaic hominin introgression using ancestral recombination graphs
new_candidates.candidate_relevance: TRACE detects archaic ancestry from present-day genomes without requiring archaic reference genomes or unadmixed outgroups. It recovers known Neanderthal/Denisovan signals and reports ghost ancestry in Africans and non-Africans, including in regions previously described as Neanderthal/Denisovan ancestry deserts.
new_candidates.epistemic_caution: The method infers genetic lineages and introgression signals; it does not identify the ghost populations with named fossil taxa such as Homo erectus or Homo heidelbergensis. Divergence/admixture estimates must not be converted into cultural, linguistic, cognitive or religious descent claims.

new_candidates.title: Aquahenosis: a non-pharmacological altered state of consciousness induced by floatation-REST in individuals with anxiety and depression
new_candidates.candidate_relevance: A secondary analysis of a randomized feasibility trial reports that Floatation-REST increased interoceptive awareness and dimensions including Oceanic Boundlessness, Disembodiment, Experience of Unity and Spiritual Experience relative to a zero-gravity-chair comparison.
new_candidates.epistemic_caution: Phenomenological overlap with psychedelic states does not imply identical mechanisms, historical ritual equivalence or supernatural causation. Mediation analyses are statistical and do not prove causal mechanisms.

new_candidates.title: Investigating Mediumship/Possession-Relevant Experiences: Contributions from a Feature-Based, Subject-Dependent Approach to Definition and Measurement
new_candidates.candidate_relevance: Develops and validates a feature-based, subject-dependent measurement approach for mediumship/possession-relevant experiences using Brazilian systematic-review, practitioner/religious-leader input, psychometric validation and representative-sample work. Supports separating phenomenological features from culturally specific interpretations.
new_candidates.epistemic_caution: Prevalence of reported experiences does not validate supernatural explanations and does not imply psychopathology. Brazilian results should not be universalized to other religious traditions or historical populations.

new_candidates.title: Late Fifth Dynasty mastaba of Yunmin and Ity at Saqqara
new_candidates.candidate_relevance: A joint Egyptian-Spanish mission reported a late Fifth Dynasty mastaba in the Mariette Cemetery with two funerary chapels belonging to Yunmin and his father Ity, including funerary texts, an offering formula, reliefs of agricultural activity and offering processions, and a false door in Ity's chapel.
new_candidates.epistemic_caution: This is field-report metadata, not a peer-reviewed excavation publication. Titles, kinship and depicted/offering practices should be transcribed from primary documentation before entity promotion. Iconography and formulae do not by themselves establish private belief states.

sources: Egypt Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities statement as reported by Xinhua 2026-09-07

new_candidates.title: Ancient-DNA reattribution of the Upton Lovell burial as biologically female
new_candidates.candidate_relevance: Wiltshire Museum reports Ancient Genomics Laboratory results identifying the individual long called the 'Upton Lovell Shaman' as biologically female, overturning a longstanding male attribution. The burial includes goldworking-related tools and unusual grave goods.
new_candidates.epistemic_caution: The full scientific report is not yet released. Biological sex does not determine gender identity, occupation or ritual role. The labels 'shaman' and 'goldworker' are archaeological interpretations and must remain distinct from the DNA observation.

contradictions_and_pressures.summary: Genomic regions depleted of Neanderthal/Denisovan ancestry are not necessarily Homo-sapiens-specific; TRACE reports other archaic ancestry in some such regions.
Similar phenomenological dimensions can arise under sensory attenuation and psychedelics without establishing mechanistic or historical equivalence.
Mediumship/possession research supports coding cross-culturally recognizable experiential features separately from participants' culturally specific explanations.
Upton Lovell illustrates that grave-goods/status assumptions can contaminate biological-sex attribution; DNA observation, craft inference and ritual-role label must remain separate.
Saqqara offering formulae, false doors and offering scenes are direct textual/material observations, but they should not be collapsed into individual private belief states.

human_review_items.action: Review inference strength, simulations and implications for any NOEMA Homo-sapiens-specific-region claims; do not map unnamed lineages to fossil taxa.
Review induction-condition → phenomenology → mechanism separation before adding altered-state ontology edges.
Review culturally sensitive feature ontology and whether NOEMA needs explicit experiential-feature vs interpretation fields.
Await/locate primary excavation publication and verified inscription transcription before entity or claim promotion.
Treat biological-sex reattribution as provisional public research release until full scientific publication; retire unsupported male attribution if repository contains it.
Verify bibliographic status and scope before substantive review.
Resolve publication-object identity by DOI; never deduplicate by title alone.
